backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the Pristine Learning platform, defining data types and persistent storage for users, teachers, bookings, reviews, messages, withdrawals, and platform configuration including Stripe and Razorpay integration with access control and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature IDs to their implementation files, components, test IDs, and confidence levels, covering Razorpay setup in AdminDashboard, Razorpay checkout integration alongside Stripe, and i18n translation additions for Razorpay.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document summarizing each frontend source file's purpose and key changes, serving as a reference for build planning across pages, components, hooks, and utilities.
frontend/index.css: Root Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for the design system's light and dark color themes, including sidebar, chart, and semantic color tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the Pristine Learning Vite/React app, mounting the React root div and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application file configuring TanStack Router with all routes including aliases, wrapping the app in QueryClient, ThemeProvider, LanguageProvider, and a RootLayout with shared Navbar, Footer, and Toaster.
frontend/src/components/BookingModal.tsx: Booking modal component that supports both Stripe and Razorpay payment gateways, fetches gateway configuration from the backend, generates time slots, and handles session booking confirmation with notifications.
Provides a shared dashboard layout with role-based sidebar navigation (admin/teacher/student), notification badge, and logout functionality using Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/DemoModeBanner.t: Displays a dismissible banner warning users they are in admin demo mode, with an option to exit and clear demo data.
frontend/src/components/DemoModeButton.t: Renders a button to enter admin demo mode by seeding local demo data and navigating to the admin dashboard without authentication.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site-wide footer with branding, quick links, support links, contact info, and social media icons using i18n translations.
frontend/src/components/MessageInbox.tsx: Implements a two-panel messaging inbox that lists conversations and displays messages for the selected conversation, with real-time polling and send functionality backed by a local store.
frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx: Renders the sticky top navigation bar with links, a language switcher, Internet Identity login/logout, and a dashboard shortcut for authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: A modal dialog that collects a new user's full name and email to create their profile, skipping itself in demo mode and calling onComplete after a successful save.
frontend/src/components/RazorpaySetupMod: A card-based form component for entering and saving Razorpay API key ID and secret, with demo-mode disabling and status display for existing configuration.
frontend/src/components/ReviewsSection.t: Displays an aggregate star rating summary and a list of individual reviews for a given teacher, fetched from the local reviews store with periodic refetching.
frontend/src/components/ReviewSubmission: A form that lets a student submit a star rating and optional text review for a completed booking, storing it in the local reviews store and invalidating related queries.
frontend/src/components/StripeSetupModal: A dialog for configuring Stripe payments by entering a secret key and managing a list of allowed country codes, saving the configuration via the backend actor.
A modal panel that shows detailed profile information, performance metrics, and activity logs for a selected user, supporting both real and demo data.
frontend/src/components/UserManagementTa: Renders a user management table with search, role, and status filters, supporting both demo and live backend data. Allows viewing individual user details via a side panel.
frontend/src/components/WeeklyAnalyticsT: Displays weekly analytics snapshots as summary cards and a bar chart, supporting demo and backend data. Includes a button to generate a new weekly snapshot.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an ICP backend actor using the current Internet Identity, initializing admin access control if a token is present. Invalidates and refetches dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context with login, logout, and status tracking via DFINITY's AuthClient. Exports a provider component and a hook for consuming the auth context.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching and mutating backend data (user profiles, activity logs, performance metrics, weekly snapshots), with demo mode fallbacks using seeded data.
frontend/src/hooks/useRazorpayCheckout.t: Provides a hook to initiate Razorpay payment checkout by dynamically loading the Razorpay script and opening the payment modal with configurable options. Returns loading state, configuration status, and the initiatePayment function.
frontend/src/hooks/useTimezone.ts: Returns the user's local timezone and its abbreviation, memoized for performance.
frontend/src/i18n/en.ts: English translation strings organized by feature namespace (nav, hero, auth, teacher, booking, subscription, admin, blog, errors, etc.).
frontend/src/i18n/index.ts: Re-exports the `en` and `ta` translation objects and the `TranslationKeys` type from their respective modules.
frontend/src/i18n/LanguageContext.tsx: Provides a React context for language switching between English and Tamil, with localStorage persistence and a nested-key translation lookup function `t()`.
frontend/src/i18n/ta.ts: Tamil translation strings mirroring the same namespace structure as `en.ts`, providing full UI localization in Tamil.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet importing Inter and Playfair Display fonts, defining Tailwind layers with a teal/amber OKLCH design-token palette for light and dark modes, and reusable component utility classes.
frontend/src/lib/localStore.ts: Client-side localStorage utility module defining TypeScript interfaces and CRUD helpers for bookings, notifications, messages, reviews, subscriptions, wallet entries, withdrawal requests, and referral codes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with `QueryClientProvider` and `InternetIdentityProvider`.
frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.tsx: Admin dashboard page displaying platform stats (total/active users, snapshots) with tabs for user management and weekly analytics, plus Stripe/Razorpay setup modals and demo mode support.
AI Study Assistant page that lets authenticated users select a curriculum and subject to generate study materials, with detailed pre-built content for Tamil Nadu Samacheer Kalvi subjects rendered in a tabbed dashboard layout.
frontend/src/pages/BlogListingPage.tsx: Displays a grid of published blog posts fetched from the local store, with cover images, metadata, and navigation to individual post pages.
frontend/src/pages/BlogPostPage.tsx: Renders a single blog post by slug with basic markdown-like content parsing, cover image, author/date metadata, and a back-to-blog navigation button.
frontend/src/pages/DemoPage.tsx: Interactive multi-step demo walkthrough page showcasing platform features (teacher search, profiles, student dashboard, etc.) with illustrated slides and navigation controls.
frontend/src/pages/Homepage.tsx: Marketing homepage with a hero section, platform stats, feature highlights, how-it-works steps, and featured teacher cards, linking to search and demo pages.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentFailure.tsx: Payment failure page that displays an error message from URL params, informs the user no charges were made, and provides retry and home navigation buttons.
frontend/src/pages/PaymentSuccess.tsx: Displays a payment success page that verifies a Stripe session via the actor, updates the local subscription store if matched, and shows appropriate success or error UI.
frontend/src/pages/SessionRecordingsPage: Shows a student's completed session recordings fetched from the local bookings store, separating sessions with and without recording URLs in a grid layout.
frontend/src/pages/StudentDashboard.tsx: Renders the student dashboard with tabs for upcoming/completed bookings, subscription status, referral link, messages, and pending review prompts, all sourced from local stores.
frontend/src/pages/SubscriptionPackagesP: Displays subscription package cards (Basic, Standard, Premium) and handles checkout via Stripe or Razorpay based on available configured payment gateways.
frontend/src/pages/TeacherDashboard.tsx: Renders the teacher dashboard with tabs for bookings, demo slot management, wallet balance, referral link, and message inbox, using local stores for data.
frontend/src/pages/TeacherProfilePage.ts: Displays a detailed teacher profile page with booking, messaging, reviews, and availability tabs. Handles demo and paid session booking via a modal, and uses local stores for user profile and conversation management.
frontend/src/pages/TeacherSearchPage.tsx: Renders a searchable, filterable list of teacher profiles with filters for subject, language, and rating. Shows loading skeletons and an error state with retry option.
frontend/src/pages/TeacherWalletPage.tsx: Shows a teacher's wallet dashboard with available balance, total earnings, pending withdrawals, and a transaction history table. Allows teachers to submit withdrawal requests via a dialog.
frontend/src/utils/formatTime.ts: Provides utility functions to format timestamps into localized date/time strings and extract timezone abbreviations using the Intl API.
frontend/src/utils/paymentGateway.ts: Provides helpers to determine available payment gateways (Stripe/Razorpay) based on config, convert USD cents to Razorpay paise, and format currency amounts for display.
frontend/src/utils/seedDemoData.ts: Seeds localStorage with demo data (users, bookings, reviews, messages, subscriptions, activity logs, metrics, weekly snapshots) for admin demo sessions, running only once per session.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities to extract URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, persist them in sessionStorage, and clean sensitive parameters from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the frontend, extending the default theme with custom colors (oklch-based design tokens, teal, amber), fonts (Inter, Playfair Display), border radii, box shadows, and keyframe animations. Includes plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Tracks the overall project state (version 39) for 'Pristine Learning', a global tutoring marketplace, documenting architectural decisions, known bugs, and a comprehensive list of implemented and planned features across frontend and backend.
